messages:
Sophie (PM): quick async qtr check — need 1-line status for the OKR milestone 'Q2 model-routing + autoscale': shipped / slipped, owner, blocker(s), next step. please ping any CRs needed.
Ava (Prod): shipped -> completed canary for route-fallback. Owner: Ava. Blocker: none. Next: monitor 24h then promote. :tada:
Liam (Eng): slipped -> end-to-end perf regression on long-seqs. Owner: Liam. Blocker: failing perf tests when batch size > 16, likely kv cache pressure.
Priya (Eng): +1 on failure. I reproduced locally with seq=2048; memory spike at kv_inflate. PR link: https://git.redwood/infra/pr/3821 (wip). Need infra help to test larger GPU mem configs.
Marco (Infra): noted. I can spin a 48GB test node but need the workload script and perf metrics. Ping me when PR is ready for staged run.
Liam (Eng): thanks @Marco. workload: `scripts/perf/run_kv_stress.sh --seq 2048 --batch 32`. metrics: latency p50/p95, OOMs. I'll attach a small repro in the PR in 30m.
Danielle (Eng Mgr): proposing short mitigation: lower default batching to 12 for hosted tier while we root cause. Ava / Sophie ok with temporary config change?
Ava (Prod): ok with temporary throttle if we include a rollback window. set for next deploy and alert on latency > 500ms.
Sophie (PM): approve. Danielle please own the rollback policy and timeline.
Danielle (Eng Mgr): will do. plan: deploy config at 04:00 UTC, monitor 6h, rollback if p95 increase > +150ms or error rate > 0.5%.
Priya (Eng): opened PR 3821 with initial fix for kv preallocation. Requesting CR from @Liam and @Marco for infra test hook.
Liam (Eng): on it, I'll review today. Quick asks in PR: add a small feature flag `kv_prealloc_v2` so we can toggle without full deploy.
Marco (Infra): CI note: to run staged 48GB, use label `infra-large-mem`. I'll attach node request to PR comments.
deploy-bot: deploy queued for 1768524000 by Danielle (eng-manager).
Liam (Eng): CR review left comments re: edge-case for short sequences; Priya can you address or respond so we can merge?
Priya (Eng): will address in a followup commit by EOD.
Ava (Prod): other small shipped items: updated docs for model-variant routing (doc link: https://docs.redwood/route-variants). No blockers.
Sophie (PM): summary for rollup: shipped -> canary route-fallback (Ava). slipped -> model-routing autoscale because kv memory perf (Liam/Priya). Infra test queued (Marco). Mitigation -> temporary batch cap (Danielle). CRs: PR 3821 (Priya) needs review from Liam; infra test hook requested.
Sophie (PM): next steps: Liam/Priya/Marco run large-mem test (+ results), Danielle deploys temp config, Ava monitors metrics and reports back in this thread in 6–12h. I'll include this in the qtr rollup doc.
Ava (Prod): will post a short metric snapshot after 6h in this thread.
Liam (Eng): test running on infra-large-mem now, ETA ~45m. posting logs here once done.
Priya (Eng): thanks all. tagging owners in PR and adding the workload script.
Marco (Infra): nods — allocated node id infra-48-12. test started.
deploy-bot: deploy started at 1768524100 for config-throttle (owner Danielle).
Ava (Prod): metric snapshot (6h check): p95 latency +20ms, errors unchanged. no rollback needed. :white_check_mark:
Sophie (PM): awesome, closing this async check. I'll mark milestone status as partial-shipped in rollup (ship: route-fallback; residual: autoscale perf). If anything else changes, reply here. Thanks!
